input.summary:
bath 1 (26..27 x 14..16, 2x3 quartz room) is built in parts/room-8.mjs: cauldron basin with a glass mirror and a sea_lantern over it on the north wall, a quartz stair WC beside it, a two-cauldron tub on the south row, and white carpet on the walk-through row.
make.sh produces a whole build.nbt; this part places 8 blocks with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes. `mcd room` says OK: 5 of 5 floor cells reachable, min light 11, no dark cells.
Checked the render from above: the basin, glowing lantern and WC read clearly; the 30 floating blocks `mcd check` reports are shell ceiling pieces at z=20..25, not this part.
left: Tub is two cauldrons, not a real bathtub: no tub helper exists, and vocab bath_fit gives a basin/mirror/WC only (no tub), so I drew it by hand.

No ceiling or beam above bath 1 (the z=14..19 vault is open to the roof), so hung_lantern cannot light this room or bath 2; the sea_lantern stands on a glass column at y=4 instead. Bath 2 needs the same workaround.
elements.md item 32 (two bathrooms) and item 35 (every room lit) are only half done: bath 1 is built, bath 2 is not. I did not tick them.
Mirror is a glass_pane column on the basin cell (y=3) rather than on the wall, because the wall at z=13 is locked to the shell.

waste.what: Worked out the 2x3 layout and the layers() rows by hand, cell by cell, to find a path that reaches every fixture.
waste.cost: about 3 minutes of reasoning and one rewrite of the layout
waste.tool: A `plan --rooms` variant that lists each free cell's neighbours and which fixture cells it can reach would make a tiny room's layout check instant.

waste.what: Had to choose the tub and light by hand (cauldrons, a sea_lantern on a glass column) because no vocab helper covers a tub, or a light in a room with no beam above it.
waste.cost: about 2 minutes of deciding and one retry of the light position
waste.tool: A `tub(g, x, z, len, axis)` helper and a `column_light(g, x, z, y, block)` helper that stacks a support under a lantern or sea_lantern, both for rooms in the vault zone where hung_lantern fails.
